setup.intro: Tune the two team strips before the game, then add the generated URLs to OBS as two browser sources. Every setting is baked into the URLs — nothing needs to be saved in OBS.
setup.urlHint: Add each strip as its own browser source so you can position them independently. The strips stay live during the draft and keep the finished draft on screen for the whole game.
